$comment: CMS-0057-F acceptance scenario manifest. It holds each scenario's id, name, capability and external-core (Augment) status per backend. It does NOT hold the Cloud Health Office (Replace) status: that comes from docs/epa-gap-matrix.md §11, and tools/Cms0057Evidence fails if a scenario here declares 'replace'. The acceptance suite validates its [Trait("Scenario",...)] against this file (see ScenarioManifestTests). Statuses are one of: PASSABLE, PARTIAL, GAP, N/A. Do not invent Facets/HealthEdge results until an integration exists.

capabilityDefinitions.PASSABLE: The repository's defined acceptance scenario is supported by the tested implementation. Not a CMS certification and not by itself production readiness for a specific payer deployment.
capabilityDefinitions.PARTIAL: Core of the scenario is implemented; some part is engagement or roadmap work.
capabilityDefinitions.GAP: Not implemented in the tested code; tracked so it is not silently claimed.
capabilityDefinitions.N/A: The scenario has no dependency on this backend/dimension.
